name: Ali Can Efe
short_bio: Independent healthcare AI strategy consultant (2026-present) based in Dubai. Former MRI Global Marketing Deputy Manager at Canon Medical Systems (2015-2026, Tokyo + Istanbul), where he led MRI global marketing across META and APAC. Specialized in AI/ML integration in healthcare, Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) optimization, Installed Base (IB) segmentation, KOL-driven market entry, and AI diagnostic imaging strategy. Background in biomedical engineering (MSc Brunel London) and electrical-electronics engineering (BSc Işık Istanbul). Active researcher in AI digital transformation of medical imaging, source-grounded AI for regulatory compliance in the MENA region, and machine-learning validation for financial time series (results published, code private).
long_bio: Independent healthcare AI strategy consultant (2026-present) based in Dubai. Former MRI Global Marketing Deputy Manager at Canon Medical Systems (2015-2026), where he led MRI global marketing across META and APAC regions, managing a multi-region portfolio across 4 key markets. Combines a biomedical engineering foundation (MSc Brunel University London, BSc Işık University Istanbul) with 10+ years of progressive healthcare product management experience. Specialized in AI/ML healthcare integration, Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) optimization, Installed Base (IB) segmentation, Account-Based Marketing (ABM), and KOL-driven market entry for AI diagnostic imaging. Has acted as Trusted Advisor to C-level stakeholders across 13+ regional offices. Keynote speaker at Arab Health Dubai 2024 and speaker at Canon satellite symposia at the Turkish Magnetic Resonance Association's annual meetings in 2022 and 2023. Now offers independent consulting on: (1) AI integration into radiology systems and medical imaging workflows; (2) custom model development for healthcare and financial firms; (3) AI-driven marketing strategy for medical device manufacturers; (4) customer satisfaction optimization and CLV/IB modernization programs. Active in three research areas: (1) AI/ML integration in MRI workflows and AI digital transformation in META/APAC healthcare markets; (2) deterministic, source-grounded AI agents for regulatory and legal compliance in the MENA region (an open-source SaMD regulatory and QARA playbook for product managers with an agent toolkit for EU MDR / FDA plans, plus open-source demonstrations for SFDA and UAE EDE medical device pre-checks, MENA AI regulation and UAE business setup); (3) machine-learning validation for financial time series, with results and methodology lessons from a private BTC research project published openly. Also publishes this profile as an open-source MCP (Model Context Protocol) server so that AI assistants can answer questions about it from a structured source.

evidence.title: SaMD-Regulatory-Playbook
evidence.description: SaMD regulatory and QARA playbook for product managers building Software as a Medical Device and AI-enabled diagnostic imaging products, written from the product side of the table: eight guides (EU MDR, FDA premarket pathways, ISO 13485, working with QARA, SaMD and AI in diagnostic imaging, agile delivery under design controls, a worked example, and the agent system), eight copy-and-adapt templates, and an agent toolkit that turns a device description into a verified EU MDR / FDA regulatory plan with a citable classification rule trace, required documents, an agile plan and follow-ups. Model reads and extracts only; classification and planning are deterministic rules over a curated knowledge base, and extracted answers must carry a verbatim source quote.
evidence.license: Guides, templates and knowledge base CC BY 4.0; source code MIT
evidence.status: Educational and planning-support material verified against official sources in September 2026; not legal, regulatory or clinical advice; agent outputs are not regulatory determinations

expertise.specialty: Machine-learning validation and signal research on BTC time series

evidence.title: BTC machine-learning research — results and validation lessons
evidence.description: Published results and methodology lessons from a private research project on BTC/USDT (1-minute data with 5-minute, 15-minute and 4-hour context). Code and data are not published. Not investment advice.
key_results: Move size (volatility) was predictable at 1 minute: Bollinger band width vs. next large move correlation 0.626; high vs. low regime 1.88x vs. 0.44x subsequent move size

Direction was not tradeable at 1 minute: single-indicator rules won ~56% but returned +0.02% against a 0.04% round-trip fee; 0 of 10 combinations held out of sample; leak-free CNN direction accuracy ~50%
Fake results were traced to future-bar leakage (71% direction accuracy, +0.062% backtest, ~15% live loss) and fixed with causal features, train-only scaling and chronological out-of-sample testing
Chronological hold-out F0.5 0.612 vs. optimistic out-of-fold 0.752, with the gap decomposed into regime shift, overfitting and embedding collapse
evidence.limitations: Single asset; research stage; no net-of-fee profitable strategy is claimed
